plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked three-stage wave-front and Mach-cone diagram from Mach and Salcher's 1887 spark photographs compares subsonic motion (v < 343 m/s, nested circles), the transonic sound barrier (v = 343 m/s = Mach 1.0, wave fronts piling up at the nose), and supersonic flight (v = 485 m/s = Mach 1.4, V-shaped Mach cone with sin θ = 1 / M).

teach_overlay.label: SUBSONIC (V < 343 M/S) VS SOUND BARRIER (MACH 1.0) VS SUPERSONIC MACH CONE (485 M/S = MACH 1.4)
teach_overlay.detail: Inked three-stage wave-front & Mach-cone diagram on period paper from Mach & Salcher's 1887 spark photographs comparing subsonic motion (v < 343 m/s, nested circles), transonic sound barrier (v = 343 m/s = Mach 1.0, wave fronts pile up into a single wall of pressure), and supersonic flight (v = 485 m/s = Mach 1.4, V-shaped Mach cone with sin θ = 1 / M)
teach_overlay.scale: a Leyden-jar spark lasting less than one-millionth of a second froze a rifle bullet moving at five hundred metres per second into a crystal-clear shadow on glass
